summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests decitabine with lisaftoclax and olverembatinib in adults with advanced chronic myeloid leukemia or Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute myeloid leukemia. Decitabine is given by IV, and lisaftoclax and olverembatinib are given by mouth; how often and for how long is not stated. The stated goal is to find the recommended doses of lisaftoclax and olverembatinib to use with decitabine, and this is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa decitabina junto con lisaftoclax y olverembatinib en adultos con leucemia mieloide crónica avanzada o leucemia mieloide aguda Filadelfia positiva. La decitabina se administra por vía intravenosa, y el lisaftoclax y el olverembatinib se administran por vía oral; la frecuencia y la duración no están indicadas. El objetivo indicado es encontrar las dosis recomendadas de lisaftoclax y olverembatinib para usarlas con decitabina, y este es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with chronic myeloid leukemia in accelerated or myeloid blast phase, or Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute myeloid leukemia.
Has been intolerant or resistant to at least one prior BCR::ABL1 TKI.
Performance status of 3 or better on the ECOG scale.
Liver, heart, kidney and pancreas function within the listed limits.
Able to give written informed consent and agree to use contraception.
not_for: Acute or chronic pancreatitis, or pancreatitis within the past year.
Serious heart problems, recent heart attack, stroke, or long QT syndrome.
Serious infection not controlled with antibiotics, or active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or uncontrolled HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
